note: Initial data for soc2_controls and soc2_event_types (phase 3). Source: stories/MapMigGon37539/soc2-event-catalog.md §5 and data-implementation-plan.md §3.

controls.name: Monitoring of system components for anomalies
controls.description: The entity monitors system components and their operation for anomalies indicative of malicious acts, natural disasters and errors (AICPA TSC 2017 CC7.2). Evidence in Map King Hub: Loom sync outcomes and the hourly triage compute run. Provisional mapping by Singular.

controls.name: Evaluation of detected events
controls.description: The entity evaluates detected events to determine whether they could prevent it from meeting its objectives and takes action (AICPA TSC 2017 CC7.3). Evidence in Map King Hub: Loom and ingestion errors, triage compute errors and the automatic task_lanes integrity fixes. Provisional mapping by Singular.

controls.name: Controls over system inputs
controls.description: The entity implements policies and procedures over system inputs, including controls over completeness and accuracy (AICPA TSC 2017 PI1.2). Evidence in Map King Hub: Ingestion Agent runs with row-level validation. Provisional mapping by Singular.

event_types.name: Loom sync started
event_types.description: Loom started a sync run, scheduled or requested in Slack #ingestion. Evidence that task aggregation runs as planned and who requested it.
event_types.detection: A loom_sync_runs row is created with status running.
event_types.qualification_notes: Attributable (agent:Loom plus requester), clear state. Loom updates its row later, so values are copied at capture.

event_types.name: Loom sync completed
event_types.description: A Loom sync finished with success or partial success, with created, updated, closed, skipped and failed counts.
event_types.detection: The status of a loom_sync_runs row changes to success or partial.
event_types.qualification_notes: Attributable, clear outcome with counts. Values copied at capture.

event_types.name: Loom sync failed
event_types.description: A Loom sync failed, or was abandoned: killed before closing its row and marked by the next run.
event_types.detection: The status of a loom_sync_runs row changes to failure or abandoned.
event_types.qualification_notes: For abandoned runs produced_at is the time the next run marked it, not the time it stopped.

event_types.name: Ingestion run started
event_types.description: The Ingestion Agent started processing a file. Not observable today: the agent writes ingestion_runs only when it finishes.
event_types.detection: Not available: needs the agent to create its ingestion_runs row with status running when it starts.
event_types.qualification_notes: Not observable until the Ingestion Agent logs its start.

event_types.name: Ingestion run completed
event_types.description: The Ingestion Agent processed a file: rows validated and staged. Completed with errors means some rows were invalid or malformed.
event_types.detection: An ingestion_runs row is created or replaced with run_status Completed or Completed with errors.
event_types.qualification_notes: run_by is free text (weak actor). Replace mode updates the row in place: event_key includes run_at, so a replacement is a new event.

event_types.name: Ingestion run failed
event_types.description: The Ingestion Agent could not write the file's rows to staging (run_status Failed).
event_types.detection: An ingestion_runs row has run_status Failed.
event_types.qualification_notes: Only covers failures the agent logs; a crash before writing leaves no row.

event_types.name: Triage compute run completed
event_types.description: The hourly command_center_triages compute automation ran and logged status ok in priority_events.
event_types.detection: A priority_events row is created with source automation, event_type triage_compute and status ok. Dry runs (summary starting with [dry run]) are excluded.
event_types.qualification_notes: Server timestamp, never deleted. Hourly volume (about 24 per day): decide every run or a daily summary before enabling.

event_types.name: Triage compute run failed
event_types.description: The hourly triage compute automation logged a status other than ok (validation or dependency failure).
event_types.detection: A priority_events row is created with source automation, event_type triage_compute and status other than ok. Dry runs excluded.

event_types.name: Task lanes integrity fix
event_types.description: The task_lanes integrity automations detected and corrected an invalid state (duplicate rows or broken ranking) and logged it.
event_types.source_workflow: task_lanes · integrity · on create / on update (wflzX39Z0Wl4xQLel, wflvV2l7S9rBYzVFS)
event_types.detection: A priority_events row is created with source automation and event_type guard_fix or dedupe.
event_types.qualification_notes: Best control evidence of the set: detection and correction of invalid states, logged with server time.
